source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 9 to 13
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 6, 2026 · 13 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Football Manager 27 SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass Football Manager 27 – November 10Game Pass Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision. Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline. Football Manager 27 Console SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ 30 ★★★★★ $59.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Football Manager 27 Console – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 Console is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Immerse yourself in the managerial journey with refined layouts that give you a clearer view of what matters most to sharpen your approach. Smarter navigation makes use of every inch of space, while fully customisable Controller Mapping puts more power in your hands, so you can tailor your setup to your gameplan. TANUKI: Pon's Summer CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 42 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass TANUKI: Pon’s Summer – November 10Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it’ll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery. As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they’ll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine’s restoration. Warhammer Survivors Auroch Digital ☆☆☆☆☆ 256 ★★★★★ $7.99 $7.19 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Warhammer Survivors – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors’ game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton. Hope in the City Lofty Sky Games and NAGA Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 79 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Hope in the City – November 11Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Your sketches may be the only clues you have. Play as 17-year-old Hope Song in this narrative mystery set in Shenyang, China. While everyone around her cracks under exam pressure, Hope escapes into her drawings, until her parents disappear. Investigate what happened, connect the clues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the city’s calm. 9 Kings Hooded Horse ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass 9 Kings (Game Preview) – November 12Game Pass Build your city into the most powerful of all kingdoms through endless combinations of buildings, units, spells, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic combos and powerful perks to break the game and become overpowered. Grow your kingdom in strategic ways, prepare for dozens of unique events, and show the world your kingdom can outlast all others in both single and async multiplayer. This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. Hozy tinyBuild ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $14.99 $11.99 Get it now Hozy – November 9XBOX Play Anywhere Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you’re wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow. Captain Coco: Treasure Island (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Captain Coco: Treasure Island – November 10 Set sail for a tropical puzzle adventure in Captain Coco: Treasure Island! Join Captain Coco, a clever pirate monkey on a mission to crack open treasure chests by pushing coconuts across mysterious island levels. But don’t be fooled by the sunny beaches and lush jungles! Every stage is a brain-teasing challenge that requires careful planning, clever moves, and a little pirate ingenuity. Hard West 2 Klabater ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $34.99 Get it now Hard West 2 – November 10 Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems. Ova Magica Top Hat Studios, Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 5 ★★★★★ $29.99 $23.99 Get it now Ova Magica – November 10Smart Delivery Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time—raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends. Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience. RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition Playstack ☆☆☆☆☆ 9 ★★★★★ $11.99 Get it now RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition – November 10XBOX Play Anywhere RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers

source.title: The Outer Worlds 2’s first DLC arrives December 2
source.evidenceText: November 10, 2026November 10, 2026 The Outer Worlds 2’s first DLC arrives December 2 3 0 39 Like this The first in a two-part Side Effects Guaranteed narrative adventure arrives soon, with part two coming spring 2027. Mikey Dowling Director of Communications, Obsidian Entertainment The time has come to expand on the experience for The Outer Worlds 2 with the first of a two-part story expansion, Side Effects Guaranteed, arriving on December 2. After a distress signal from a derelict ship is picked up, you and your crew quickly get embroiled into the story of an abandoned settlement, a power struggle for the future of the Sub Rosa criminal organization, and the fate of a team who has been subjected to something that will cause them all to die from explosive cell death. Really, it’s more a liquefaction than explosion, but it means death nonetheless. Play Video A brand new story filled with moral quandaries and consequences big and small isn’t the only thing you’ll experience in the first DLC. An Earth Directorate Commander should always be sure to have a weapon at their side, and there are five new weapons to add to the arsenal. Such as the Immobilizer. Think of it like a gun that makes gravity forget to exist around its target, allowing them to float in the air, so you can switch to another weapon and pick them off as you like. Great for combining with grenades for anti-gravity explosions or the Tactical Time Dilation device for slowing down time and getting some critical shots in. There is also the 1/6 Resolver that allows every sixth bullet that is fired from it to pack an extra special punch. For those who built their characters just right, they won’t have to empty the gun every time to get that critical hit, either. Other weapons include a weapon that does additional damage to creatures, a special Tossball Stick, and a new plasma weapon for some energy fun. Yet it isn’t all about the weapons. Side Effects Guaranteed will also bring with it a level cap increase up to 36, new perks, new flaws, and a new Sub Rosa radio station with 20 new songs. There is also the all-new region of Elysium Valley to explore with unique quests and new facilities to make your way through. That’s a lot of new! While the events of the DLC do trigger right before the point of no return in the main game, there is also a way to jump easily into the action. From the main menu if you start a new game, you will see an option to start Side Effects Guaranteed directly. This will load a pre-made character at level 27 that you can assign skill points and perks to so you can experience the DLC however you’d like and get started right away. Not happy with the character you made (or the one you already have)? Coming to everyone at the same time as the release of Side Effects Guaranteed is a new update that will allow players to respec their character at any time. And for those who want more skills to play around with, a new addition to the custom game options allows you to adjust how many skill points you get per level. Find the balance that is right for you. Or become an Earth Director demi-god. Your worlds, your way. But remember, however you decide to deal with Sub Rosa or the subjects of Elysium Valley will have consequences. Side effects, some might say, that will lead directly into the next installment of The Outer Worlds 2 two-part story expansion when it releases in the spring of 2027. Until then, may skill catch you where fortune fails. Side Effects Guaranteed releases on December 2nd or is available in the Premium Edition or Premium Edition Upgrade for The Outer Worlds 2.
